top_signals.title: Stocks Slide With Dollar as Count Favors Democrats: Markets Wrap
top_signals.summary: The growing prospect of a Democratic sweep of Congress rippled across global markets, sending US stock-index futures and the dollar lower while boosting Treasuries as early election returns threatened to put the brakes on President Donald Trump’s agenda.

top_signals.title: Disaster management minister visits areas in Kumamoto affected by July quake
top_signals.summary: Goshi Hosono called on the central government to support local governments while stressing the need to improve conditions at evacuation centers.
